title: Unify golangci-lint configs for common, image, and storage
body:
The container-libs currently has three separate .golangci.yml files (common/, image/, storage/) with overlapping baselines (gofumpt, modernize, issue caps, QF1008 disabled) but very different linter sets. Common enables ~40 linters while image/storage stay minimal.

Consolidate into a single root config that preserves today’s effective per-module rules via path-based exclusions, then update Makefiles and CI to use it and remove the per-module configs.

comments.body: This attracts … tinkerers. I’m not saying the linters never find anything but I think the cost-benefit ratio is questionable. (Today’s activity is sort of an example.)
